Message:
Hey, didja know?
I was born in a small village
deeep in the mountains.
I really, really like the village!

Not to mention Mommy,
Daddy, and eeeveryone
else who lives in it.
I love each and every bit!

One day,
Mommy said this to me.

“Your smile never fails to
keep my spirits up, Shiloh.”

Hehehe! Really?
That makes me sooo happy!

“Looks like Shiloh’s
got a magic smile.
One that makes
everyone happy.”

Daddy’s face was
bright and smiling, too.

Magic...!
That’s sooo cool!
Daddy said my smile
was magic!

That means only one thing!
To make sure Mommy and
Daddy are always
super-duper happy,
I just have to keep smiling!

Whenever I smiled,
they’d always
smile back at me.

I always thought
these happy days
would never end...
